about: Expected reading of v1's built-in sample meeting (fictional, from src/base/MeetingGraph.orig.html) against sample-board.csv seeded as of 2026-09-24. Project codes are the page's defaults. Thread IDs are as minted by the seed. 'project' is where the item belongs; for an item on a thread it is the thread's project.
